title: お辞儀・挨拶する人
subject_en: Flat-style people bowing or greeting politely, each ONE person full body, centred, simple friendly faces, varied ages and genders. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 保育士や看護師、新入社員、店員など、お辞儀や挨拶をする人物素材12点です。案内状やお知らせに使えます。
